alerts.title: Iran war live: Saudi-led coalition strikes Yemen; ships on fire in Hormuz
alerts.why: Escalation in the Strait of Hormuz threatens global oil supply chokepoints, triggering immediate geopolitical risk premiums across crude benchmarks.

alerts.title: Fresh tanker strike adds to bloody week in Hormuz
alerts.why: Attacks in the Strait of Hormuz threaten vital crude supply chokepoints, driving significant geopolitical risk premia into Brent prices.

itemsSent.title: ‘Status quo’ between US and Iran could break out into war, analysts warn
itemsSent.why: Geopolitical tension in the Middle East provides a risk premium, though markets remain skeptical of an imminent escalation to full-scale war.

itemsSent.title: US official says Hormuz insurance hits $64m: Is the strait really open?
itemsSent.why: Rising insurance costs for Hormuz transit act as a de facto risk premium, tightening supply chain logistics and increasing global crude landed costs.

itemsSent.title: EIA: US crude oil inventories up 3.4 million bbl
itemsSent.why: US crude inventories rose by 3.4 million barrels, indicating weaker demand or higher supply, exerting downward pressure on WTI prices.

itemsSent.title: Fed’s Waller warns inflation is worsening, floats 50-basis-point December hike
itemsSent.why: Hawkish Fed rhetoric strengthens the dollar and raises recession fears, weighing on global oil demand outlook.

itemsSent.title: The October FOMC minutes: Officials sounded worried the pause would be misread. Some hawks said they could accept it only if markets “clearly understood” more tightening was likely. www.wsj.com/econom
itemsSent.why: Hawkish Fed minutes signal potential for higher-for-longer interest rates, strengthening the dollar and weighing on global oil demand expectations.

itemsSent.title: Kerch Strait Bridge Strike Cuts Off Sea of Azov Shipping
itemsSent.why: Geopolitical escalation in the Black Sea region increases risk premiums for regional energy transit and supply chain stability.

itemsSent.title: Fed’s Williams says more rate hikes likely needed amid inflation
itemsSent.why: Higher interest rates strengthen the dollar and dampen economic growth expectations, weighing on crude oil demand outlook.

itemsSent.title: Clean tankers freight slumps as Persian Gulf transits slow amid attacks
itemsSent.why: Reduced refined product exports from the Persian Gulf tighten supply in key markets, supporting diesel and gasoline prices despite lower tanker demand.

itemsSent.title: Equinor Hack Adds to Wave of Cyberattacks on Energy Companies
itemsSent.why: Cyberattacks on critical energy infrastructure create supply uncertainty and risk premiums, particularly for European gas markets already facing geopolitical volatility.

itemsSent.title: U.S. Naval Blockade Now Covers Vessels That Load Iranian Cargo at Sea
itemsSent.why: Increased enforcement on Iranian oil exports tightens global supply, potentially removing sanctioned barrels from the market.
